analysis: static canonical JSON serialization and byte arithmetic only; no caller/source/AST execution, no pipe experiment, no mock
delivery_scope: For a conforming pipe with enough available space, <=PIPE_BUF writes atomically. Empty conforming pipe has room; full/insufficient pipe can EAGAIN. Target PC_PIPE_BUF/capacity/schedule/delivery not measured. No universal one-write success guarantee.
general_bound: Let E be the byte length of JSON-escaped root content, without its two quote bytes. SOURCE <=281+E; COPY <=277+E. The fixed root has E=96. Bounds use maximum CLI integer width, conservative21-digit end and maximum7-digit file length. Actual encoded length is checked; longer/escaped roots that exceed512 fail without attempting success stdout. No earlier root admission changes.
pipe_predicates: success only: FIFO fstat; actual fpathconf(1,PC_PIPE_BUF) integer>=512; encoded bytes<=512; single nonblocking write exact-count check
